Narrative and Plans for
Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for
3144 W. Diversey Avenue, Chicago
Rezoning from RS-3 to a B2-2

The subject property is improved with a 2 story frame multi-family residential building.
The applicant to demo the existing building. He needs a zoning change to a B2-2 District
to meet the bulk and density standards to build a new 3-unit residential building.

A. Proposed Land Use: A new 3 unit residential building

B. Project floor area ratio: 1.43 FAR

C. Project Density (Lot area per dwelling unit): lot area is 3,125 SF +3 units = 1,041 SF

per dwelling unit.
D. The amount of off-street parking: 3 parking spaces
E. Setbacks:

Front: 13.50”

East: 1”

Rear: 30.0’

West: 0”

F. Building height: 40’ — 5”
